stem: The caterpillar’s actions while building its cocoon support the idea that it is —

options.label: A
options.text: too impatient to argue with the ant and the bee

options.label: B
options.text: confused by the questions the ant and the bee are asking

options.label: C
options.text: unconcerned about what the ant and the bee think about its house

options.label: D
options.text: afraid to show the ant and the bee the best way to make a house
